# Therapist.com

> Therapist.com is a comprehensive mental health resource providing evidence-based information on therapy types, mental health disorders, relationships, and personal development.

The site features educational guides written by licensed mental health professionals including Brooks Baer (LCPC, CMHP), Dr. Robert Bogenberger (PhD), and Dr. Stephanie Steinman (PhD, CSAC). Content spans traditional and alternative treatments, with particular depth in psychedelic-assisted therapy, attachment theory, and LGBTQIA+ mental health.

## Key Topics

- Mental health conditions and disorders
- Attachment theory and relationship patterns
- Psychedelic therapy (psilocybin, MDMA, ketamine, LSD)
- Anxiety and stress management
- Trauma and PTSD treatment
- LGBTQIA+ mental health
- Psychopharmacology and psychiatric medication
- Grief and bereavement
- Self-awareness and personal development
- Therapeutic modalities and techniques
- Relationship counseling and dating
- Play therapy for children
- Alternative and holistic treatments
- Personality disorders
- Life stages and transitions

## Mental Health Disorders & Conditions

- [Acute stress disorder: Signs, causes, and impacts](https://therapist.com/disorders/acute-stress-disorder): Guide to ASD symptoms, trauma response, and comparison with PTSD
- [Psychopathy: Signs, causes, and treatment](https://therapist.com/disorders/psychopathy): Guide to psychopathy and antisocial personality disorder (ASPD) treatment
- [5 of the best breathing exercises for anxiety](https://therapist.com/disorders/anxiety/breathing-exercises-for-anxiety): Research-backed breathing techniques for anxiety relief and stress management
- [Maladaptive daydreaming: Signs, causes, and treatment](https://therapist.com/behaviors/maladaptive-daydreaming): Treatment guide for excessive daydreaming disorder and fantasy behavior

## Therapy Types & Treatment Approaches

- [Psychedelic therapy: How it works, benefits, dangers](https://therapist.com/types-of-therapy/psychedelic-therapy): Guide to psychedelic therapy using LSD, psilocybin, MDMA, and ketamine
- [Play therapy: Types and techniques](https://therapist.com/types-of-therapy/play-therapy): Guide to play therapy techniques for children's emotional expression
- [Psychopharmacology: How medication helps mental health](https://therapist.com/medication/psychopharmacology): Guide to psychiatric medications and psychopharmacology principles

## Relationships & Attachment

- [Struggling with relationships as an adult? Your attachment style may be why](https://therapist.com/relationships/attachment-theory-styles/how-attachment-style-affects-adult-relationships): Guide to attachment styles and their impact on adult relationships
- [Navigating pace discrepancies in your relationship: Advice from Dr. Alexandra Solomon](https://therapist.com/for-therapists/pace-discrepancies): Dr. Solomon's advice on managing relationship timing and pace differences
- [How to start dating again](https://therapist.com/relationships/how-to-start-dating-again): Dating advice for re-entering relationships after divorce or breakup

## Self-Development & Personal Growth

- [The power of self-awareness: The anatomy of the whole self](https://therapist.com/self-awareness/anatomy-whole-self): Part 2 series on self-awareness, neurobiology, and attachment theory
- [Goal setting: Tips and techniques](https://therapist.com/self-development/goal-setting): Self-development guide for setting and achieving personal goals
- [How to spot and resist perfectionism](https://therapist.com/personality/how-to-resist-perfectionism): Guide to identifying and overcoming perfectionism and self-criticism

## Grief & Life Transitions

- [How long does grief last?](https://therapist.com/grief/how-long-does-grief-last): Advice on grief timeline, stages, and coping with bereavement
- [Grief, bipolar disorder, and a father's love](https://therapist.com/grief/grief-bipolar-love): Personal story on managing grief and bipolar disorder after parental loss
- [Taking our anxiety back to school](https://therapist.com/disorders/anxiety/taking-our-anxiety-back-to-school): Practical advice for managing back-to-school anxiety in children and parents
- [Life Stages](https://therapist.com/life-stages): Main category page for life stages content including aging and midlife

## Identity & LGBTQIA+ Resources

- [Aromantic: Definition, signs, benefits, and challenges](https://therapist.com/identity/lgbtqia/aromantic): Educational guide on aromanticism and the aromantic spectrum

## Optional

- [Déjà vu: What it is and why it happens](https://therapist.com/brain-and-body/deja-vu): Explanation of déjà vu phenomenon and memory processes by Dr. Bogenberger
- [Rakhi Shingala, LCPC, provides online therapy](https://therapist.com/clinician/rakhi-shingala-60348): Profile for IL therapist Rakhi Shingala specializing in DBT and trauma
